content.text:
**Finding: compliant** — no MFN obligation burdens us.

- Full-document searches for MFN language (*most favored*, *favorable/favourable*, *no less favorable*, *as favorable as*, *match*, *best price*, *offered to any Third Party*) returned nothing on point.
- Article 6 (Payments and Records) and Article 5 (Grant of Rights) were read in full: consideration is fixed upfront/milestone/royalty amounts, with no obligation for AbbVie to give Harpoon terms no less favourable than those granted to third parties, and no obligation to match third-party offers.
- The only third-party-terms mechanics run in our favour or are elective for us: §5.9.3 gives AbbVie an *option* to take a license under Harpoon's Proposed Future In-Licensed Rights and accept those terms; §13.2.2 simply confirms AbbVie's payment obligations run in favour of Harpoon's permitted assignee.

This satisfies the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer), so no redline was proposed.
